newsitem.title: USA: BMW '96 sales up nine pct to over 640,000.
newsitem.headline: BMW '96 sales up nine pct to over 640,000.

text.p: German carmaker BMW AG said on Monday that its sales in 1996 were up nine percent to over 640,000, compared with 595,056 vehicles in 1995.
The Bavarian-based BMW and its U.K. unit Rover had combined production worldwide of over 1.1 million vehicles in 1996, compared with 1.098 million the previous year, BMW said in Detroit.

BMW said that Rover would exceed 500,000 vehicles in 1996 production, compared with 503,526 the previous year. Exact figures would be made available on Tuesday, while BMW's 1996 figures would be released at end January.

In the United States, BMW production was 105,761, a 13 percent increase on the previous year when the group's U.S. business produced 93,309 cars and the first time the group has exceeded 100,000 cars in the U.S market.
The carmaker said it sold more cars than any other manufacturer in the $30,000-$50,000 dollar category.
